news.title: Alonso updates on Caicedo’s game-changing injury
news.title_zh: 阿隆索更新了凯塞多改变比赛规则的伤势
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso feels the injury suffered by Moises Caicedo against Leeds United played a big part in changing the momentum of the game in the visitors’ favour, but knows Chelsea need to respond to those setbacks better in the future. The Blues suffered a 4-1 defeat to Leeds at Stamford Bridge on Saturday afternoon, in our first game since the international break. Caicedo started the game wearing the captain’s armband, but a collision left him in some pain, and eventually brought an early end to his game when the Ecuadorian was replaced by Jordan Henderson in the 22nd minute. ‘It's a knock and we need to wait until tomorrow to see how he is,’ said Alonso, when asked if Caicedo’s injury was serious after the game. ‘He was in pain and let's see how bad it is.’ Although we took the lead shortly after that enforced change, through Emmanuel Emegha’s first Chelsea goal, Leeds responded to level the scores almost immediately and we struggled to recover control of the game after the double setbacks of Caicedo’s injury and Noah Okafor’s goal. ‘What went wrong was after their equaliser, after the change with Moi, we lost completely the momentum,’ continued the Blues manager. ‘Until then we were doing okay. I think that we were creating, playing a lot on the pitch. We were coming out from the pressure, but from that moment, they started believing, we started not believing. ‘After that, we never got the good feeling mentally in any moment and we were not able to come out from the pressure, we didn't get close to their goal, so it completely changed the game.’ Responding to those setbacks is an area our manager knows we need to improve, something he sees as a joint responsibility among himself and his squad. ‘I feel that as a team, as a collective, together we need to support each other,’ Alonso added. ‘Today, together, we need to find solutions to do better because this will happen. ‘On the pitch, they need to go through those moments to say: "Okay, we are still in the game, we still have many minutes to play and the game is not over”. ‘The game still had so many minutes to play and we felt that we didn't recover that good momentum.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索认为莫伊塞斯·凯塞多在对阵利兹联的比赛中受伤，在很大程度上改变了比赛的势头，有利于客队，但他知道切尔西未来需要更好地应对这些挫折。周六下午，蓝军在斯坦福桥以 4-1 输给利兹联，这是我们自国际比赛日以来的第一场比赛。凯塞多戴着队长袖标开始比赛，但一次碰撞让他感到一些疼痛，并最终在第22分钟被乔丹·亨德森换下，提前结束了比赛。 “这是一次打击，我们需要等到明天才能看到他的情况，”赛后被问及凯塞多的伤势是否严重时，阿隆索说道。 “他很痛苦，让我们看看情况有多糟糕。”尽管我们在强制换人后不久就取得了领先，但通过伊曼纽尔·埃梅加的第一个切尔西进球，利兹几乎立即将比分扳平，在凯塞多受伤和诺亚·奥卡福进球的双重挫折后，我们很难恢复对比赛的控制。 “问题出在他们扳平比分之后，在莫伊的改变之后，我们完全失去了动力，”蓝军主教练继续说道。 '在那之前我们都做得很好。我认为我们在场上创造了很多机会，踢了很多比赛。我们从压力中走出来，但从那一刻起，他们开始相信，我们开始不相信。 “在那之后，我们的精神状态在任何时候都没有良好的感觉，我们无法摆脱压力，我们没有接近他们的目标，所以这完全改变了比赛。”应对这些挫折是我们的主教练知道我们需要改进的一个领域，他认为这是他自己和他的球队的共同责任。 “我觉得作为一个团队，作为一个集体，我们需要互相支持，”阿隆索补充道。 “今天，我们需要共同找到解决方案，做得更好，因为这将会发生。 “在球场上，他们需要经历那些时刻，然后说：‘好吧，我们还在比赛中，我们还有很多分钟要踢，比赛还没有结束’。” “比赛还有很长的时间，我们觉得我们没有恢复那种良好的势头。”

news.title: Bompastor provides Mayra Ramirez and Manaka Matsukubo injury update
news.title_zh: Bompastor 提供了 Mayra Ramirez 和 Manaka Matsukubo 的伤情更新
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has given an update on Mayra Ramirez and Manaka Matsukubo, with the Chelsea duo eyeing a return from injury. Ramirez missed almost the entire 2025-26 season after undergoing surgery on a hamstring problem, but has been targeting a return to first-team action. After being spotted back with the squad following the win against Paris Saint-Germain in the UEFA Women’s Champions League in midweek, Bompastor was asked how close Ramirez is to making a return for the Blues - but the manager said patience will be key before the striker returns. ‘Yeah, so Mayra is back in the country,’ Bompastor said. ‘I think we are working with her on fitness to make sure she is back with us on the pitch. ‘For now, she is still rehabbing, and she has not been part of the training sessions with the squad. ‘So we need to take the international break also to keep assessing her and see how she evolves, and I will have an update - probably a better update - after the international break. 'But yeah, she missed a lot of the season, the beginning of the season, so she needs time to build up again.' Matsukubo, meanwhile, missed the clash against PSG and was an unused substitute during the Women’s Super League draw against Liverpool. Bompastor said that while the attacker was available to play, she preferred to use other options off the bench following the injury. ‘Yeah, Manaka got a pain in her glute, so we decided to have her in the squad [rather than starting] today,’ Bompastor said. ‘Probably she still wasn't 100 per cent. From what I could observe, I felt other profiles would have been better in this game to come in.’
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·博姆帕斯托更新了迈拉·拉米雷斯和马纳卡·松久保的最新情况，切尔西二人组希望伤愈复出。拉米雷斯因腿筋问题接受手术后几乎缺席了整个 2025-26 赛季，但他一直致力于重返一线队。周中在欧洲女足冠军联赛中战胜巴黎圣日耳曼队后，邦帕斯特被发现重返球队，被问到拉米雷斯距离回归蓝军还有多远，但主教练表示，在前锋回归之前，耐心将是关键。 “是的，梅拉回到了国内，”邦帕斯特说。 “我认为我们正在与她一起进行健康训练，以确保她能回到球场上和我们在一起。 “目前，她仍在康复中，她还没有参加球队的训练。 “因此，我们还需要利用国际比赛日来继续评估她，看看她如何发展，国际比赛日之后我将得到一个更新——可能是一个更好的更新。” “但是，是的，她错过了赛季的很多比赛，赛季初的比赛，所以她需要时间重新恢复。”与此同时，松久保错过了对阵巴黎圣日耳曼的比赛，并在女超联赛对阵利物浦的比赛中替补出场，没有上场。邦帕斯特表示，虽然这名攻击手可以上场，但她在受伤后更愿意使用替补席上的其他选择。 “是的，玛娜卡的臀部疼痛，所以我们今天决定让她进入球队（而不是首发），”邦帕斯特说。 “也许她还没有百分百恢复健康。据我观察，我觉得在这款游戏中加入其他配置文件会更好。

news.title: Match report: Chelsea 1-4 Leeds
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：切尔西 1-4 利兹联
news.body_en: Chelsea succumbed to defeat to Leeds United in the Premier League despite Emmanuel Emegha marking his full debut with his first goal for the club. It was initially the Blues who looked to be the strongest side when we took control of possession midway through the first half, and then the lead when Emegha smashed in the first goal of his Chelsea career left-footed, after good work by Morgan Rogers to tee him up. It was not to last, though, as a couple of minutes later a Leeds long-ball gave them the opportunity to level the scores through Noah Okafor. It remained all square at half-time, but early in the second half the visitors were awarded a penalty when a shot struck Rogers high on the arm, allowing Dominic Calvert-Lewin to take the lead from the spot. Leeds extended their advantage when Okafor got his second of the game from close range after a long-throw was only half cleared and then, as we tried to find a way back into the game, Brendan Aaronson got another for Leeds on the counter late on, sealing Chelsea's fate. Xabi Alonso made four changes to his team, with Emmanuel Emegha leading the attack on his first start for Chelsea, supported by Estevao Willian, Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers. Romea Lavia and Moises Caicedo continued in midfield, the latter as captain. Behind them, Josh Acheampong returned to the defence alongside Levi Colwill, Wesley Fofana and Pep Chavarria, with Emiliano Martinez back in goal for the Blues. As always when these two old rivals meet, both sets of supporters were making plenty of noise as this game kicked off at Stamford Bridge. On the pitch, it was a slightly cagey opening, as the two teams probed for openings. Emegha set out his stall early on his full Chelsea debut, giving the home fans a taste of what he is all about by mixing it up with the Leeds centre-backs and making his physical presence felt. It was the home side who gradually began to control proceedings, with Acheampong and Estevao in particular linking up well on our right flank at the start. Rogers was trying to find his range from just outside the box with a couple of efforts, but neither keeper had been tested after 15 minutes. However, when Leeds managed to produce their first spell of pressure in the Chelsea half, it almost gave them the opening goal, when Calvert-Lewin got his head on the end of James Justin’s cross, with Martinez relieved to see it come back off the crossbar. Earlier, Caicedo had needed lengthy treatment on his back following a collision in the air, and eventually he was unable to continue, handing the captain’s armband to Colwill as he was replaced by Jordan Henderson midway through the first half. Shortly afterwards, the Blues put that set-back behind us by taking the lead. Rogers got the better of Justin to bring the ball down, surge past Muharemovic in the middle and feed Emegha down the channel. The striker steadied himself and unleashed a venomous left-foot shot to beat Trafford at his near post. It was quite the introduction to the Bridge supporters. Unfortunately, our lead lasted less than three minutes, as Leeds hit straight back. A long ball caused problems as it dropped out of the sky and broke for Okafor in a dangerous position. He carried the ball into the box and was able to divert his finish into the bottom corner to level the scores. The game continued fairly evenly balanced after those two quick goals, but it was Leeds who came closest when Calvert-Lewin flicked a cross wide and headed too close to a grateful Martinez. Muharemovic did get the ball in the net as Leeds' high balls proved dangerous, but it was ruled out for a clear offside, meaning the teams went in for the half-time break level. There was a slightly chaotic start to the second half amidst a series of appeals from both teams, largely ignored by referee Michael Oliver. That was until a shot ricocheted off Rogers in the box five minutes in. Leeds appealed, the penalty was given, and Martinez had no chance as Calvert-Lewin fired into the bottom corner. Rogers tried to hit straight back after we fell behind, but his shot was too close to Trafford to trouble the keeper, and as we attempted to regroup and push back, we fell further behind. It all came from a long throw which was only cleared as far as the edge of the box. Rogers got a foot to Ampadu’s cross but couldn’t prevent it reaching Okafor, who struck into the top corner on the half-volley, from too close for Martinez to react. Alonso turned to his bench in response as Pedro Neto and Danny Welbeck were introduced to our attack, soon followed onto the pitch by Malo Gusto and Geovany Quenda. It seemed to have the desired effect as we regained control of the ball and began to pen Leeds back deep into their own half with 20 minutes remaining, but with a two-goal deficit there was plenty of work to do if Chelsea were to salvage anything from this game. The Blues worked hard for little reward, though. With their lead secured, Leeds dug in stubbornly to prevent us from carving out clear chances. Instead it was the visitors who scored again on the counter, through substitute Brendan Aaronson in added time. Chelsea are in action early next weekend, travelling away to Nottingham Forest for the Premier League's Friday evening kick-off on 27 November. Kick-off is at 8pm. 尽管伊曼纽尔·埃梅加打进了俱乐部的第一个进球，但切尔西在英超联赛中还是输给了利兹联。当我们在上半场中段控制控球权时，一开始蓝军看上去是最强的一方，随后在摩根·罗杰斯的出色帮助下，埃梅加用左脚攻入了他在切尔西职业生涯的第一个进球，蓝军也取得了领先。不过，这种情况并没有持续多久，几分钟后，利兹联队的长传给了他们通过诺阿·奥卡福扳平比分的机会。半场结束时双方仍保持平局，但下半场一开始，客队因射门击中罗杰斯的高臂而获得点球，让多米尼克·卡尔维特-勒温取得领先。奥卡福在一次长传仅半球解围后近距离射门，利兹队扩大了优势，然后，当我们试图找到重返比赛的方法时，布伦丹·阿伦森在反击中为利兹队再进一球，锁定了切尔西的命运。哈比·阿隆索对他的球队进行了四次调整，伊曼纽尔·埃梅加在切尔西的第一次首发中领先进攻，埃斯特沃·威廉、科尔·帕尔默和摩根·罗杰斯也得到了支持。罗米亚·拉维亚和莫伊塞斯·凯塞多继续担任中场，后者担任队长。在他们身后，乔什·阿奇姆蓬（Josh Acheampong）与列维·科尔威尔（Levi Colwill）、韦斯利·福法纳（Wesley Fofana）和佩普·查瓦里亚（Pep Chavarria）一起回到后防线，埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯（Emiliano Martinez）重新为蓝军守门。和往常一样，当这两个老对手相遇时，当这场比赛在斯坦福桥拉开帷幕时，两队球迷都发出了很大的喧闹声。在球场上，这是一个稍微谨慎的开局，两支球队都在寻找空位。埃梅加在他的切尔西首秀中很早就摆出了自己的位置，通过与利兹联中后卫的混合并让主场球迷感受到他的身体存在，让主场球迷领略到他的魅力。主队逐渐开始控制比赛，尤其是阿奇姆蓬和埃斯特瓦一开始就在我们的右翼配合得很好。罗杰斯试图在禁区外通过几次努力找到射程，但 15 分钟后两名门将都没有受到考验。然而，当利兹联在切尔西半场第一次施压时，卡尔弗特-勒温接到詹姆斯·贾斯汀的传中头球攻门，马丁内斯松了口气，看到球从横梁上弹了回来。早些时候，凯塞多在空中发生碰撞后背部需要长时间治疗，最终他无法继续比赛，将队长袖标交给了科尔威尔，上半场中途被乔丹·亨德森换下。不久之后，蓝军取得领先，将这一挫折抛在了身后。罗杰斯战胜了贾斯汀，将球带下，冲过中路的穆哈雷莫维奇，将球传给了埃梅加。这名前锋稳住了自己，并在近门柱处射出一脚恶毒的左脚射门，击败了特拉福德。这是对大桥支持者的介绍。不幸的是，我们的领先优势持续了不到三分钟，利兹联队立即反击。一个长传球从天而降，为处于危险位置的奥卡福带来了麻烦。他将球带入禁区，并将射门转移到底角，将比分扳平。在这两个快速进球之后，比赛继续相当平衡，但当卡尔弗特-勒温轻弹传中并头球距离感激的马丁内斯太近时，利兹联队最接近。穆哈雷莫维奇确实将球射入网中，利兹联的高球被证明是危险的，但由于明显越位而被排除，这意味着球队在半场休息时扳平了比分。下半场开局稍显混乱，两支球队都提出了一系列上诉，但裁判迈克尔·奥利弗基本上没有理睬。直到五分钟后，罗杰斯在禁区内射门被弹射。利兹联上诉，点球被判，马丁内斯没有机会，卡尔弗特-勒温射入底角。在我们落后后，罗杰斯试图直接反击，但他的射门距离特拉福德太近，无法给守门员造成麻烦，当我们试图重新集结并反击时，我们进一步落后了。这一切都来自一次长传，但只到了禁区边缘。罗杰斯一脚接住了阿姆帕杜的传中，但无法阻止球传到奥卡福，奥卡福的半凌空射门打进球门上角，距离太近，马丁内斯无法做出反应。 当佩德罗·内托和丹尼·维尔贝克加入我们的进攻时，阿隆索转向替补席回应，很快马洛·古斯托和乔瓦尼·昆达也上场了。这似乎达到了预期的效果，我们重新控制了球权，并在比赛还剩 20 分钟时开始将利兹联逼回本方半场，但在两球落后的情况下，如果切尔西想要从这场比赛中挽回什么，还有很多工作要做。然而，蓝调队努力工作却没有得到什么回报。在确保领先优势后，利兹联顽强地防守，阻止我们创造明显的机会。相反，客队在补时阶段替补登场的布伦丹·阿伦森在反击中再次进球。切尔西将于下周末早些时候开始行动，前往诺丁汉森林参加 11 月 27 news.body_en: Chelsea were held to a draw away at Liverpool in the Women's Super League, with the Blues dominant but unable to force a winner. The result pushed us a further point clear at the top of the table, with Manchester City in action on Sunday afternoon. The Blues were on top early in the first half before Liverpool forced their way into the game before the break. However, after half-time it was all Chelsea as Sonia Bompastor's side went in search of a winner. While the Blues will undoubtedly be frustrated not to come away with all three points, they maintained their unbeaten start to the season. Bompastor made two alterations from the 1-0 UEFA Women’s Champions League win over Paris Saint-Germain, with Lucy Bronze replacing Nathalie Bjorn in defence. Elsewhere, Sjoeke Nusken came in for Aggie Beever-Jones. After a cautious opening 10 minutes, Hannah Hampton was the first goalkeeper called into action. However, it was a fairly tame header that proved an easy stop for our No.1. Moments later came the first real opening for the Blues as Ellie Carpenter raced down the right flank, pushing into the area before looking for Sandy Baltimore with a cut-back. It would have been a certain goal for Baltimore, but the pass was cut out by a Liverpool defender. Keira Walsh then had an effort from just inside the area, but her curled attempt flew wide of the post. The Blues kept the pressure on, with Lexi Potter flashing an effort wide from outside the area. Liverpool's first chance of real note came after 24 minutes, with a blocked clearance allowing Vivien Endemann to get on the ball in the area. However, her lay-off to Natalia Ramos was dragged well wide by the Spanish star. We continued to press forward with Walsh seeing a shot blocked after a short corner, before Alyssa Thompson came close to opening the scoring. The 22-year-old broke forward before firing in a left-footed shot that was pushed over the bar by Khiara Keating. Fuka Nagano then forced a great stop from Hampton. The keeper was alert as the ball dropped to the Liverpool attacker, stopping a fierce effort before gathering the ball at the second attempt. Ramos then came close for the visitors with a free-kick, whipping the ball just over the bar. Both teams went in search of an opener before the break, with Endemann pouncing on a loose pass before firing a shot harmlessly over the bar for the hosts. Ramos then had a shot from outside the box which Hampton did well to parry before collecting. The Blues attacked quickly with five minutes left as Baltimore was found in space down the left, but she couldn't find the back of the net with Keating closing down the angle in the Liverpool goal - as the score remained level at the break. We came out strong to start again, with Carpenter forcing Keating into an intervention from a cross, while Walsh showed quick feet before having a shot blocked. Walsh then forced another save from Keating, her high shot palmed over the bar. From the corner, Veerle Buurman almost poked an effort home but saw her attempt blocked. Bompastor did not leave it long to make a change, with Lola Brown making her way onto the pitch around 10 minutes into the second half, replacing Baltimore. Brown had an instant impact, playing a nice one-two before delivering a cross into the centre, where Thompson just couldn't get over the ball to put her header on target. Carpenter quickly earned another corner for the Blues, flying down the right before firing in a cross which almost deceived Keating. With just over 20 minutes remaining, Brown fired in another dangerous cross; this time Nusken saw a powerful volley pushed behind by the Liverpool keeper. As we entered the final quarter of the contest, Brown fired in another dangerous cross, this time Nusken saw a powerful volley pushed behind by Keating. Walsh then had a snapshot which seemed to take everyone by surprise before rolling just wide. Following a scramble in the area, Broze did well to find Walsh again on the right side of the area, but her shot was again well-saved by Keating. Potter then had an opportunity, attempting to place an effort past Keating but seeing her shot stopped. Bompastor made one last throw of the dice in the final 10 minutes as Beever-Jones, Erin Cuthbert and Giulia Dragoni were introduced, with Thompson, Kaptein and Nusken making way. A stop-start finish to the game ensued, with the Blues unable to create any more clear-cut chances before referee Ben Speedie blew up for full-time. We remain unbeaten and go two points clear at the top of the Women’s Super League, but will head into the international break in second place if Manchester City beat Tottenham on Sunday. This was the last fixture before the final international break of the year. That means we are not back in action until Saturday 12 December, when we take on London City Lionesses at Stamford Bridge in the Women's Super League. And you can secure your spot by clicking here. news.body_zh: 女超联赛中，切尔西客场战平利物浦，蓝军占据优势，但无力逼胜。这一结果使我们在积分榜上进一步领先，曼城将在周日下午进行比赛。蓝军在上半场一开始就占据领先地位，但利物浦在中场休息前强行进入比赛。然而，半场结束后，一切都变成了切尔西的比赛，索尼娅·邦帕斯特的球队开始寻找胜利者。尽管蓝军未能全取三分无疑会感到沮丧，但他们仍保持了赛季不败的开局。邦帕斯托在女足欧冠1-0战胜巴黎圣日耳曼的比赛中做出了两次调整，露西·布朗泽取代了纳塔莉·比约恩担任后防线。在其他地方，斯乔克·努斯肯 (Sjoeke Nusken) 代替阿吉·比弗·琼斯 (Aggie Beever-Jones)。开场 10 分钟后，汉娜·汉普顿 (Hannah Hampton) 成为第一个上场的门将。然而，这是一个相当温和的头球，事实证明我们的一号球员很容易停下来。不久之后，蓝军迎来了第一个真正的空档，埃莉·卡彭特从右翼冲下，冲入禁区，然后寻找桑迪·巴尔的摩的后切。对于巴尔的摩来说，这本来是一个必进球，但传球被利物浦后卫挡出。凯拉·沃尔什随后在禁区内射门，但她的弧线射门偏出门柱。蓝军继续施加压力，莱克西·波特在禁区外的一脚射门偏出。利物浦队的第一次真正机会出现在第 24 分钟后，一次被阻挡的解围让维维安·恩德曼 (Vivien Endemann) 在禁区内得球。然而，她对纳塔利娅·拉莫斯的断球却被这位西班牙球星拖得远远的。我们继续向前推进，沃尔什在一个短角球后看到射门被挡出，随后艾莉莎·汤普森差点率先得分。这位 22 岁的球员向前突破，然后左脚射门，被基亚拉·基廷 (Khiara Keating) 推高出横梁。长野风花随后强行阻止汉普顿。当球落到利物浦进攻球员手中时，守门员保持了警惕，阻止了他的猛烈射门，然后在第二次尝试时将球接住。随后拉莫斯为客队主罚任意球，皮球高出横梁。中场休息前，两支球队都在寻找破门机会，恩德曼接到一次松散的传球后，为主队射门，但没有造成任何伤害。随后拉莫斯在禁区外射门，汉普顿很好地挡住了球。还剩五分钟时，蓝军迅速进攻，巴尔的摩在左路找到了空当，但基廷封堵了利物浦球门的角度，但她未能进球，中场休息时比分仍持平。我们再次开始强势，卡彭特在传中迫使基廷介入，而沃尔什在射门被挡之前表现出敏捷的脚步。沃尔什随后迫使基廷再次扑救，她的高射却高出了横梁。维尔勒·布尔曼 (Veerle Buurman) 在角球处几乎要射门，但她的射门被挡出。邦帕斯特没等多久就做出了改变，下半场大约10分钟左右，洛拉·布朗上场替换巴尔的摩。布朗立即发挥了作用，打出了漂亮的二过一配合，然后传中到中路，汤普森却无法越过球将头球击中目标。卡彭特很快为蓝军赢得了另一个角球，他从右侧飞过，然后传中，险些骗过基廷。比赛还剩20多分钟时，布朗再次射出危险传中；这次努斯肯看到一记强力抽射，被利物浦门将推到了身后。当我们进入比赛的最后四分之一时，布朗再次射出危险的传中，这一次努斯肯看到了基廷的大力抽射。沃尔什随后的一记快照似乎让所有人都大吃一惊，但随后却偏出了球门。在禁区争抢后，布罗兹在禁区右侧再次找到沃尔什，但她的射门再次被基廷扑出。波特随后有机会，试图将球射过基廷，但看到她的射门停了下来。邦帕斯特在最后 10 分钟投出了最后一次骰子，比弗-琼斯、艾琳·库斯伯特和朱利亚·德拉格尼上场，汤普森、卡普坦和努斯肯让路。比赛随后陷入停顿，蓝军无法再创造任何明确的机会，直到裁判本·斯皮迪（Ben Speedie）吹响了全场比赛的哨音。 我们保持不败，在女超联赛中领先两分，但如果曼城周日击败托特纳姆热刺，我们将以第二名的身份进入国际比赛日。这是今年最后一场国际比赛日之前的最后一场比赛。这意味着我们要等到 12 月 12 日星期六才能恢复比赛，届时我们将在斯坦福桥迎战女子超级联赛的伦敦城狮队。您可以点击此处确保您的席位。切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特（比约恩 73）、布尔曼、青铜（中）、麦凯布、卡普坦（德拉戈尼 83）、沃尔什、波特、努斯肯（卡斯伯特 83）、巴尔的摩（布朗 54）、汤普森（比弗-琼斯 83）未上场替补：彭、布坎南、滨野、松久保 利物浦：基廷、克尔、克拉克、菲斯克(c)、阿格雷兹、沃德（贝尔纳比 89）、长野、拉莫斯、恩德曼（伯格斯特罗姆 62）、奥尔森、卡波奇未上场替补：柯比、恩德比、霍宾格、伍德汉姆、板村、肖、特鲁曼

news.title: Xabi Alonso on Emmanuel Emegha selection for Leeds clash
news.title_zh: 哈比·阿隆索谈伊曼纽尔·埃梅加入选利兹联比赛
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso believes Emmanuel Emegha is ready to take his opportunity against Leeds United, as the Dutch forward prepares to make his first start for the Blues. Chelsea return to Stamford Bridge following the two-week international break, with Alonso determined to see his side get back to winning ways against Leeds. The forward made his Blues debut in our Carabao Cup clash against Liverpool and earned his first Premier League minutes against Sunderland before the international break, and now Alonso has included him from the off for the first time this afternoon. Explaining his selection, Alonso said: 'We have seen a lot from him, but he needed to build his fitness because he had picked up a few injuries. Now he's been training for a long time, he's played some minutes, he's been patiently working hard and now he's got the chance to start. 'And today, hopefully, he has a good game and he's feeling good.' With Emegha joined in attack by Cole Palmer, Morgan Rogers and Estevao Willian, Alonso is hoping to see plenty of creativity from his side. However, the Blues manager has stressed that maintaining the right balance between attack and defence will be crucial against Leeds. The boss continued: 'Our attacking players need to be ready to defend, ready to have this solidity that is needed in these kind of games. 'But as well, we need creativity, we need to be a threat in the last third. With these players we can have it, but we need to play a complete game.'
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索相信伊曼纽尔·埃梅加已经准备好在对阵利兹联的比赛中抓住机会，这位荷兰前锋正在准备为蓝军首次首发。切尔西在两周的国际比赛日结束后重返斯坦福桥，阿隆索决心看到他的球队在对阵利兹联的比赛中重新取得胜利。这位前锋在卡拉宝杯对阵利物浦的比赛中完成了他的蓝军首秀，并在国际比赛日之前对阵桑德兰的比赛中赢得了他的第一个英超出场时间，现在阿隆索今天下午首次将他纳入其中。在解释他的选择时，阿隆索说：“我们从他身上看到了很多，但他需要增强体能，因为他受了一些伤。现在他已经训练了很长时间，也打了一些分钟，他一直在耐心努力，现在他有机会首发了。 “今天，希望他能打出一场精彩的比赛，而且他感觉很好。”随着埃梅加加入科尔·帕尔默、摩根·罗杰斯和埃斯特沃·威廉的进攻，阿隆索希望看到他身边的大量创造力。然而，蓝军主帅强调，在进攻和防守之间保持适当的平衡对于对阵利兹联至关重要。主帅继续说道：“我们的进攻球员需要做好防守准备，做好此类比赛所需的稳定性准备。 “但同样，我们需要创造力，我们需要在最后三分之一形成威胁。有了这些球员，我们就可以做到，但我们需要打出一场完整的比赛。”

news.title: Confirmed Chelsea line up vs Leeds
news.title_zh: 确认切尔西对阵利兹联的阵容
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has made four changes to his starting line-up for today’s fixture against Leeds United, with Emmanuel Emegha coming in to make his full Chelsea debut in attack. Emegha looks set to lead the line as the central striker, making his first start for the Blues after coming off the bench against Sunderland and Liverpool. He will be supported by Estevao Willian, Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers, as Pedro Neto and Jordan Henderson drop out. Romea Lavia and Moises Caicedo continue in midfield, the latter as captain. Behind them, Josh Acheampong returns to the defence alongside Levi Colwill, Wesley Fofana and Pep Chavarria. Emiliano Martinez is back in goal for the Blues for his first appearance since suffering a fractured jaw at Everton. Mike Penders and Marco Palestra are the other two players to make way, with both among the substitutes this afternoon. Leeds have made one change to the team which beat Tottenham Hotspur 1-0 before the international break, as Noah Okafor relaces Lukas Nmecha in their front three. They are captained by former Chelsea youngster Ethan Ampadu. Chelsea: Martinez, Acheampong, Fofana, Colwill, Chavarria, Lavia, Caicedo (c), Estevao, Palmer, Rogers, Emegha Substitutes: Penders, Subuloye, Gusto, Palestra, Barco, Henderson, Neto, Quenda, Welbeck Leeds: Trafford, Justin, Muharemovic, Elvedi, Bogle, Ampadu (c), Tanaka, Gudmundsson, Longstaff, Okafor, Calvert-Lewin Substitutes: Zetterer, Bijol Rodon, Bard, Stach, Aaronson, James, Wilson, Nmecha
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索在今天对阵利兹联的比赛中对首发阵容进行了四次调整，伊曼纽尔·埃梅加上场完成了他在切尔西的首秀。埃梅加看起来将作为中锋领先，这是他在对阵桑德兰和利物浦的比赛中替补出场后首次为蓝军首发。由于佩德罗·内托和乔丹·亨德森退出，他将得到埃斯特沃·威廉、科尔·帕尔默和摩根·罗杰斯的支持。罗米亚·拉维亚和莫伊塞斯·凯塞多继续担任中场，后者担任队长。在他们身后，乔什·阿奇姆蓬 (Josh Acheampong) 与列维·科尔威尔 (Levi Colwill)、韦斯利·福法纳 (Wesley Fofana) 和佩普·查瓦里亚 (Pep Chavarria) 一起回归防守。埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯在埃弗顿遭遇下巴骨折后首次代表蓝军出场。迈克·彭德斯和马科·帕莱斯特拉是另外两名让位的球员，两人都是今天下午的替补球员。利兹联队在国际比赛日之前以 1-0 击败托特纳姆热刺队的阵容中做出了一项调整，诺阿·奥卡福取代了卢卡斯·恩梅查担任前三名。他们的队长是前切尔西年轻球员伊桑·安帕杜。切尔西：马丁内斯、阿奇姆蓬、福法纳、科尔威尔、查瓦里亚、拉维亚、凯塞多（中）、埃斯特瓦奥、帕尔默、罗杰斯、埃梅加替补：彭德斯、苏布洛耶、古斯托、帕莱斯特拉、巴科、亨德森、内托、昆达、维尔贝克利兹联：特拉福德、贾斯汀、穆哈雷莫维奇、埃尔维迪、博格尔、阿姆帕杜（中）、田中古德蒙德森、朗斯塔夫、奥卡福、卡尔弗特-列文替补：泽特勒、比霍尔·罗登、巴德、斯塔赫、阿伦森、詹姆斯、威尔逊、恩梅查
